BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says God has removed the nation far, unto all the ends of the earth, and the psalmist says God's praise is like his name — unto the ends of the earth. The word is the limit, the farthest reach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's praise reaches the ends of the earth because his name does, and the far edge of the land is not beyond him.
